tasks.title: Create review-prompts.test.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts. TR-003: reads both code-review `PROMPT.md` files and asserts the FR-003(a–h) and FR-004 contract on each — no phase-wide `(.tasks[].status) = "completed"`, `Gate authority is one-way` present, the MUST-flip-status contract inside ``, every `.phases[]` selector uses `$pid`/`$PHASE_ID` and none a bare number, the read-back verification present, `APPEND ONLY` present, the JSON-Intent-Format warning present, the inverted anti-patterns present — plus byte-identity of the two files (TC-007) REVIEW FAIL (code): the prompt-contract guard asserts the wrong artifact — FR-001/FR-002/TR-003. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:43-53 EXPECTED: TR-003 guards the PROMPT.md the runtime actually dispatches. PluginLoader builds `builtInBase = path.join(import.meta.dirname, "builtins")` (src/plugins/loader.ts:274), which for the compiled entry point is `dist/plugins/builtins`. The suite must either resolve from the repo root and assert BOTH copies, or this phase's gate must carry `diff -q src/... dist/...`. ACTUAL: `HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` pins all 57 cases to the `src/` copy. Phase 01's only `diff -q` is cli-vs-webapp — both under `src/`. REPRODUCED: restoring `dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md` from `a57a68f^` (D1 phase-wide force-complete `.tasks[].status) = "completed"` present, grep count 1) without rebuilding leaves 70/70 phase tests green, T001's inline gate exit 0 and T002-gate.sh exit 0 — while every live code review is dispatched the defective prompt. FIX: resolve PROMPT.md paths from the repo root and run the 57-case contract over `src/` and `dist/` as a matrix, or add `diff -q src/plugins/builtins/reviews/

/PROMPT.md dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/

/PROMPT.md` to this phase's gate. Do not defer to Phase 06 T009. GATE: T001 inline gateScript — no assertion covers dist/; gates/T001-gate.sh does not exist REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md TC-005 ("prompt changes go live via postbuild; dist/ is shared mutable state") REVIEW FAIL (code): the D9 negative guard is section-scoped and escapable — FR-002/TR-003. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:260,278-284 EXPECTED: the banned doctrine "Using tasks.json status as primary verdict when gates exist (gates are truth)" is refused ANYWHERE in the prompt, like its sibling negatives which assert against `FLAT`/`PROMPT` (lines 118, 142, 146, 156, 180). ACTUAL: `const anti = flatten(mdSection(PROMPT, "## Anti-Patterns"))` scopes the assertion to one section. REPRODUCED: inserting that exact sentence into `` in BOTH twin prompts (so the cli/webapp `diff -q` still passes) leaves 57/57 green; same for ``. Those are the sections where the agent reads it with MORE authority than an anti-pattern bullet. FIX: assert this negative against `FLAT` (the whole flattened prompt), not `anti`. GATE: T001 inline gateScript — its D1 negatives are whole-file greps, but nothing covers the D9 text REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-002 REVIEW FAIL (code): the new test file is published inside the live plugin tree — TC-005. WHERE: src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts:1 EXPECTED: the suite lives outside the tree `postbuild` copies verbatim into `dist/`, so no uncompiled `.ts` test importing `vitest` ships in the package. ACTUAL: package.json postbuild runs `cp -r src/plugins/builtins/* dist/plugins/builtins/`, and tsconfig excludes `**/*.test.ts`, so the copy is the only path in. VERIFIED: `dist/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts` exists (13545 bytes) and `files: ["dist/", ...]` publishes it, inside the tree `PluginLoader.listPlugins` scans (loader.ts:184). FIX: move the suite to `src/engine/review-prompts.test.ts` (or `src/plugins/builtins/reviews.prompts.test.ts`) resolving PROMPT.md paths from the repo root — which also fixes the src-vs-dist finding above — or exclude `*.test.ts` from the postbuild copy. GATE: T001 inline gateScript — no assertion covers the packaged artifact REF: spec.md TC-005 REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T001, gate: npm run build npx vitest run src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts npx vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts diff -q src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md grep -q 'Gate authority is one-way' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md grep -q 'Gate authority is one-way' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md grep -q 'APPEND ONLY' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md grep -q 'VERDICT CHANNEL' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts grep -q 'Do NOT touch tasks belonging to any OTHER phase' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts grep -q 'REVIEW FINDING|REVIEW FAIL' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts grep -q 'NOT "any open task → NO-GO"' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts # Negative assertions use the if-form: `! grep -q` is exempt from `set -e` and can never fail a gate. if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-cli' >&2; exit 1; fi if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-webapp' >&2; exit 1; fi if grep -q 'note them in your summary but do NOT change its status' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts; then echo 'FAIL: the D10 sentence is back in the scope context' >&2; exit 1; fi # Named-case existence: a `-t` filter exits 0 on no match, so assert against the test source instead. grep -q 'tells the review agent that re-opening the task is the NO-GO' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q "no longer tells it to leave a completed task's status alone" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q 'still forbids touching tasks from other phases' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts grep -q "readVerdict's doc comment states the real rule" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts): The review agent re-opened this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing. NOTE (retry, iteration 2): the prompt-contract suite moved to src/engine/review-prompts.test.ts — `postbuild` copies src/plugins/builtins/* into dist/ verbatim and `files: ["dist/"]` publishes it, so the old location shipped an uncompiled vitest file inside the live plugin tree (TC-005). It now resolves PROMPT.md from the repo root and runs the contract over src/ AND dist/. The declared gateScript delegates to gates/T00X-gate.sh, which is the artifact runTaskGate actually executes; the shared assertions live in gates/phase-01-contract.sh. REVIEW PASS (code, iteration 2): every finding from the previous pass verified fixed by mutation probe. - src-vs-dist coverage: the suite resolves PROMPT.md from REPO_ROOT and runs the FR-003/FR-004 contract over ROOTS = ["src","dist"]; the gate adds diff -q src<->dist for both twins. - D9 negative: now asserted against FLAT. PROBE: reinserting the banned doctrine into in BOTH twins (so diff -q stays clean) -> 4 cases RED. - packaged artifact: suite moved to src/engine/; find dist/plugins/builtins/reviews -name "*.test.ts" is empty and the gate asserts it. - state mock: loadTaskStateReturns keys off dispatchToAgent call count > 0, not a call index; TR-012 drives stageCodeReview and stageUatReview. PROBE: diffing after-vs-after at :500 -> 6 cases RED, including both stageCodeReview cases. - FR-007 doc block: moved to immediately precede `private async readVerdict`; asserted by a perl adjacency check in the gate and by a test. PROBE: the HEAD~1 arrangement -> RED. - FR-006 third format: a gateless "no gate" note case plus the three reviewDriven prompt markers and a negative control. PROBE: deleting the third alternative from the filters at :2154/:2186 -> RED (was green before). - dead gateScript: gates/T001-gate.sh created, both gates and both gateScript fields delegate to gates/phase-01-contract.sh (the artifact runTaskGate strategy 1 executes); the BRE alternation is split into two separate grep -q calls. VERIFIED: phase-01-contract.sh exit 0; 156 tests pass across review-prompts, review-finding-liveness, review-gate-divergence, review.test. Orchestrator change is comment-only (doc block relocation), no behaviour change, as plan.md Phase 01 specifies.

tasks.title: Update ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
tasks.description:
MODIFY src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts. TR-007: read `src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts` and assert `readVerdict`'s doc comment states the real rule and no longer claims "any open task → NO-GO"

REVIEW FAIL (code): the shared mock contract makes the suite miss the real entry point — FR-008/TR-012.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:111-122
  EXPECTED: `loadTaskStateReturns(before, after)` returns the pre-dispatch snapshot to
    `executeReviewWorkflow`'s `beforeState` regardless of which entry point drives the review, so a
    re-open is detected through `stageCodeReview`/`stageUatReview` — the paths `gwrk ship` calls.
  ACTUAL: "Call 1 is the pre-dispatch snapshot" holds only for a direct `executeReviewWorkflow` call.
    `stageCodeReview` calls `loadTaskState` at src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts:1331 to build
    `phaseTasks`, consuming call 1, so `beforeState` (:429) receives the AFTER state and
    `detectReviewReopens` diffs after-vs-after -> empty set. REPRODUCED: with
    `loadTaskStateReturns(stateWith("completed",{gateScript}), stateWith("open",{gateScript}))` and
    `runTaskGate` passing, `executeReviewWorkflow` -> `state.reviewVerdict === "NO-GO"` (passes) while
    the IDENTICAL state through `stageCodeReview` -> "GO" (fails: expected 'GO' to be 'NO-GO'). The
    D10 block masks this by passing one object as both before and after (:261).
  FIX: key the mock off its argument or count calls per entry point (e.g. return `before` until
    `dispatchToAgent` is called, `after` afterwards) and add a case that drives `stageCodeReview`.
    TR-012 is specified as the runs #2727/#2728 shape end-to-end; written with this helper it is a
    silent false GO — the exact false-green class this feature exists to remove.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — runs the suite only; no assertion distinguishes the entry points
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-008, TR-012

REVIEW FAIL (code): the TR-007 doc-comment guard never checks attachment, and the comment is orphaned — FR-007.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:324-330;
    src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts:1412-1421,1461
  EXPECTED: FR-007 requires `readVerdict`'s doc comment to describe what the code does, so the guard
    must assert the block IMMEDIATELY PRECEDES the declaration, e.g.
    /\/\*\*[\s\S]*?NOT "any open task → NO-GO"[\s\S]*?\*\/\s*private async readVerdict/
  ACTUAL: `(src.match(/\/\*\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g) ?? []).find(b => b.includes('NOT "any open task →
    NO-GO"'))` scans EVERY doc block in the file and accepts it wherever it sits. It sits at
    :1412-1421, immediately followed by a SECOND `/** */` block (:1422-1429) documenting
    `detectReviewReopens` (:1431). `readVerdict` (:1461) therefore has NO doc comment: an IDE hover
    shows nothing and JSDoc/TS attribute the correction text to `detectReviewReopens`. plan.md's
    "Verified starting state" table records this as "present (W2) — :1414-1422", so the misplacement
    survived both the plan's verification pass and this new guard.
  FIX: move the block to immediately above `private async readVerdict` and tighten the assertion to
    require adjacency to the declaration.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — the named-case grep proves only that the test exists, not that it binds
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-007

REVIEW FAIL (code): D5 guards two of FR-006's three note formats and none of the prompt widening — FR-006/TR-006.
  WHERE: src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts:209-235
  EXPECTED: FR-006 requires the DIAGNOSE filter to match `REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE`, `REVIEW FINDING`
    AND `REVIEW FAIL`, and requires the review-driven prompt to state the build is green and ask for a
    gate or test per fix under a widened persona.
  ACTUAL: only `DIVERGENCE` and `REVIEW FAIL` are covered. `REVIEW FINDING (` is the note W2's own new
    gateless branch writes (ship-orchestrator.ts:1502) — the newest and likeliest to be dropped — and
    nothing asserts the `reviewDriven` block (:2185-2205: "You are a build and code-review
    diagnostician", "## Review Findings (build and gates are GREEN)", "a finding that survives its own
    fix is a finding that will recur"). REPRODUCED: deleting `REVIEW FINDING|` from the regexes at
    :2154 and :2186 leaves all 70 phase tests green and gates/T002-gate.sh exit 0.
  FIX: add a D5 case for a `REVIEW FINDING (T00X, no gate):` description, and assertions over the
    reviewDriven prompt's three marker strings.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — passes with the regex alternative deleted
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-006, TR-006

REVIEW FAIL (code): T002's declared gateScript is dead text; the executed gate asserts almost nothing.
  WHERE: specs/028-review-finding-liveness/gates/T002-gate.sh:1-12 vs
    specs/028-review-finding-liveness/.gwrk/tasks.json T002.gateScript
  EXPECTED: the ~20 assertions declared in T002's `gateScript` (build, two vitest runs, cli/webapp
    `diff -q`, the `Gate authority is one-way` / `APPEND ONLY` / `VERDICT CHANNEL` greps, the three D1
    and D10 negative guards, the four named-case greps) form T002's mechanical baseline.
  ACTUAL: `runTaskGate` strategy 1 (src/utils/gate-exec.ts:64-74) unconditionally prefers the
    convention file `gates/<id>-gate.sh` when it exists and returns; T002's field is NEVER executed.
    `gates/T002-gate.sh` only does `test -f` plus one `pnpm vitest run` on the suite. Every content
    assertion is inert — which is why the `REVIEW FINDING|` mutation above left it green while T001's
    inline gate (no `gates/T001-gate.sh` exists, so it falls to strategy 3) caught it.
  FIX: write the declared assertions INTO `gates/T002-gate.sh` (the file is the executed artifact) and
    generate `gates/T001-gate.sh` so both tasks share one baseline. Separately, replace
    `grep -q 'REVIEW FINDING|REVIEW FAIL'` with `grep -qE` or two `grep -q` calls: in BRE `|` is a
    literal, so that assertion currently proves only that the file contains that 27-char JS regex
    source, and refactoring to the equivalent /REVIEW (FINDING|FAIL)/ would turn it red while fully
    satisfying FR-006.
  GATE: gates/T002-gate.sh — the gate itself is the defect
  REF: plan.md Phase 01; spec.md FR-006; specs/024 gate-assertion-contract

REVIEW/GATE DIVERGENCE (T002, gate: npm run build
npx vitest run src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-prompts.test.ts
npx vitest run src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
diff -q src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md
grep -q 'Gate authority is one-way' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md

grep -q 'REVIEW FINDING|REVIEW FAIL' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts
grep -q 'NOT "any open task → NO-GO"' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts
# Negative assertions use the if-form: `! grep -q` is exempt from `set -e` and can never fail a gate.
if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-cli/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-cli' >&2; exit 1; fi
if grep -q 'tasks\[\].status) = "completed"' src/plugins/builtins/reviews/review-code-webapp/PROMPT.md; then echo 'FAIL: D1 phase-wide force-complete is back in review-code-webapp' >&2; exit 1; fi
if grep -q 'note them in your summary but do NOT change its status' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.ts; then echo 'FAIL: the D10 sentence is back in the scope context' >&2; exit 1; fi
# Named-case existence: a `-t` filter exits 0 on no match, so assert against the test source instead.
grep -q 'tells the review agent that re-opening the task is the NO-GO' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
grep -q "no longer tells it to leave a completed task's status alone" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
grep -q 'still forbids touching tasks from other phases' src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts
grep -q "readVerdict's doc comment states the real rule" src/engine/ship-orchestrator.review-finding-liveness.test.ts):
The review agent re-opened this task and its gate still passes, so the gate does not cover what review found. Add a test that fails on it, then fix, before completing.

NOTE (retry, iteration 2): the prompt-contract suite moved to src/engine/review-prompts.test.ts — `postbuild` copies src/plugins/builtins/* into dist/ verbatim and `files: ["dist/"]` publishes it, so the old location shipped an uncompiled vitest file inside the live plugin tree (TC-005). It now resolves PROMPT.md from the repo root and runs the contract over src/ AND dist/. The declared gateScript delegates to gates/T00X-gate.sh, which is the artifact runTaskGate actually executes; the shared assertions live in gates/phase-01-contract.sh.

REVIEW PASS (code, iteration 2): every finding from the previous pass verified fixed by mutation probe.
  - src-vs-dist coverage: the suite resolves PROMPT.md from REPO_ROOT and runs the FR-003/FR-004 contract over ROOTS = ["src","dist"]; the gate adds diff -q src<->dist for both twins.
  - D9 negative: now asserted against FLAT. PROBE: reinserting the banned doctrine into <verdict_criteria> in BOTH twins (so diff -q stays clean) -> 4 cases RED.
  - packaged artifact: suite moved to src/engine/; find dist/plugins/builtins/reviews -name "*.test.ts" is empty and the gate asserts it.
  - state mock: loadTaskStateReturns keys off dispatchToAgent call count > 0, not a call index; TR-012 drives stageCodeReview and stageUatReview. PROBE: diffing after-vs-after at :500 -> 6 cases RED, including both stageCodeReview cases.
  - FR-007 doc block: moved to immediately precede `private async readVerdict`; asserted by a perl adjacency check in the gate and by a test. PROBE: the HEAD~1 arrangement -> RED.
  - FR-006 third format: a gateless "no gate" note case plus the three reviewDriven prompt markers and a negative control. PROBE: deleting the third alternative from the filters at :2154/:2186 -> RED (was green before).
  - dead gateScript: gates/T001-gate.sh created, both gates and both gateScript fields delegate to gates/phase-01-contract.sh (the artifact runTaskGate strategy 1 executes); the BRE alternation is split into two separate grep -q calls.
  VERIFIED: phase-01-contract.sh exit 0; 156 tests pass across review-prompts, review-finding-liveness, review-gate-divergence, review.test.
  Orchestrator change is comment-only (doc block relocation), no behaviour change, as plan.md Phase 01 specifies.

# VR-002: the suite exits non-zero on the 3 known server.test.ts daemon-spawn failures, so capture and
# assert the invariant instead of the exit code. NO_COLOR keeps the log ANSI-free for an exact match.
# Both `|| true` guards are deliberate: the run fails on the known quarantine, and grep exits 1 when a
# fully green run yields no FAIL lines. The assertions that decide this gate all read captured files.
NO_COLOR=1 npm run test:ci > /tmp/028-test-ci.log 2>&1 || true
grep -E '^ *FAIL ' /tmp/028-test-ci.log > /tmp/028-test-ci-failures.log || true
if grep -vq 'src/commands/server.test.ts' /tmp/028-test-ci-failures.log; then echo 'FAIL: a test failed outside the known server.test.ts daemon-spawn quarantine' >&2; exit 1; fi
